newsitem.title: USA: Sandata in talks to buy benefits company.
newsitem.headline: Sandata in talks to buy benefits company.

text.p: Sandata Inc said Thursday it entered negotiations to acquire the prescription benefits management company National Medical Health Card Systems Inc.

National Medical Health Card Systems Inc manages prescription drug programs for HMOs, employers, local governments, union groups, and third party administrators. The company has 42,000 U.S. pharmacies participating in its network.
The company had 1996 revenue of $57 million.
Sandata did not provide further details, such as the price it would pay in a potential deal. Officials at the company were not immediately available to comment.
